notes: Browser helpers, PWA/app residuals, and browser automation tooling caches under $HOME on macOS. Focus: Chrome Apps residuals, Edge/WebView residual leaves, Electron Fiddle, NW.js, CEF samples, browser pickers (Browserosaurus/Choosy/Velja/OpenIn/Default Browser), Safari Technology Preview + WebKit nightlies, deeper Playwright/Puppeteer/Cypress binary trees, Selenium/WebdriverIO drivers, BrowserStack Local / Sauce Connect / LambdaTest Underpass tunnels, Lighthouse CI and PageSpeed residual caches. Excludes cookies, Login Data, History, Bookmarks, keychains, whole browser profiles, and project test artifacts (cypress/videos, playwright-report). Prefer quit-app-first for Electron helpers and browsers. Deeper leaves extend shallow coverage already present in batch-03 (ms-playwright/Cypress roots) and batch-07 (Chrome Apps.localized).
sources: Playwright docs: ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright browser binary layout (chromium/firefox/webkit/ffmpeg/headless_shell revision folders)
Puppeteer docs: ~/.cache/puppeteer Chrome for Testing + chrome-headless-shell (v19+)
Cypress advanced install: ~/Library/Caches/Cypress binary cache; Application Support/Logs residual
Selenium Manager: ~/.cache/selenium drivers and browsers; Python webdriver-manager ~/.wdm
WebdriverIO BrowserStack service: ~/.browserstack local binary cache
Homebrew cask zap: electron-fiddle, nwjs, browserosaurus, choosy, openin, safari-technology-preview, browserstacklocal
CEF docs: macOS default ~/Library/Application Support/CEF/User Data cache_path roots
Live host: ms-playwright chromium/ffmpeg/webkit revision dirs; org.webkit.Playwright; Microsoft EdgeUpdater caches

rules.name: Chrome Apps and installed PWA shortcut residuals
rules.description: Legacy Chrome Apps.localized trees and channel-local PWA/app shortcut bundles under user Applications and Application Support. Regenerable after reinstalling PWAs from chrome://apps.
rules.notes: Removes desktop/Dock PWA wrappers only. Does not wipe browser profiles, cookies, or extensions. User may need to re-install PWAs.

rules.name: Edge WebView / EdgeUpdater residual caches
rules.description: Microsoft Edge embedded WebView-style residual folders and EdgeUpdater package caches on macOS. App-scoped EBWebView trees when present under Application Support.
rules.notes: WebView2 is primarily Windows; macOS residuals still appear via EdgeUpdater and some Microsoft embeds. Prefer include_globs so host app profiles outside cache leaves stay intact.

rules.name: Electron Fiddle caches and fiddle-core downloads
rules.description: Electron Fiddle electron version downloads (fiddle-core), app cache, HTTP storage, and logs. Large regenerable binary cache for experimenting with Electron versions.
rules.notes: Does not delete Application Support/Electron Fiddle project list (user fiddles). fiddle-core re-downloads Electron versions on demand.

rules.name: NW.js caches and residual app data
rules.description: NW.js (node-webkit) SDK sample/app caches under Library Caches and Application Support.
rules.notes: Medium: Application Support may hold sample app state. Prefer cache leaves via include_globs.

rules.name: CEF sample and user-data caches
rules.description: Chromium Embedded Framework default user-data and cefclient/cefsimple sample caches on macOS.
rules.notes: CEF default root_cache_path on macOS is under Application Support/CEF. Only cache-like leaves when AS root is targeted.

rules.name: Browserosaurus caches and residual state
rules.description: Browserosaurus (retired browser prompter) caches and Application Support residual. Preferences plist left alone when only caches targeted.
rules.notes: Application Support/Browserosaurus may hold browser list config; not wiped by default (cache/log only).

rules.name: Choosy caches and HTTP storage
rules.description: Choosy browser-picker regenerable caches and HTTPStorages. Does not remove rules/config under Application Support/Choosy.
rules.notes: Leave Application Support/Choosy and browser NativeMessagingHosts registrations; those are configuration.

rules.name: Velja caches and HTTP storage
rules.description: Velja (Sindre Sorhus browser picker) caches, including team-id-prefixed cache folders when present.
rules.notes: Does not remove Preferences or browser rules. Team-id prefix 42f94541 observed in uninstall guides.

rules.name: OpenIn caches and HTTP storage
rules.description: OpenIn (loshadki) link router caches and HTTPStorages. Containers hold preferences; only caches targeted.
rules.notes: Leave Containers and Preferences for routing rules.

rules.name: Default Browser helper caches
rules.description: Sindre Default Browser helper and related default-browser switcher caches.
rules.notes: CLI default-browser leaves little on disk; caches are regenerative stubs when present.

rules.name: Safari Technology Preview caches
rules.description: Safari Technology Preview HTTP/WebKit caches, WebKit data, and container caches. Regenerable; not History/Bookmarks.
rules.notes: Close STP first. Library/SafariTechnologyPreview can mix cache with reading-list style data; exclude bookmark/history-like names.

rules.name: WebKit nightly MiniBrowser caches
rules.description: WebKit nightly / MiniBrowser / WebKitTestRunner style caches under org.webkit.* identifiers.
rules.notes: Playwright ships a WebKit build whose support process may also create org.webkit.Playwright under Caches (overlap with playwright rule).

rules.name: Playwright browser download cache (deep)
rules.description: Full Playwright browser binary tree: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, ffmpeg, headless shell, and Go/driver side caches. Large regenerable downloads.
rules.notes: Reclaim often multi-GB. Re-run npx playwright install. Respect PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH if customized outside these roots (not discovered here).

rules.name: Puppeteer Chrome for Testing downloads
rules.description: Puppeteer v19+ global browser cache (~/.cache/puppeteer) holding Chrome for Testing and chrome-headless-shell builds.
rules.notes: Re-download via npx puppeteer browsers install. Project-local .cache/puppeteer under repos not targeted.

rules.name: Cypress binary cache and residual app data
rules.description: Cypress versioned binary cache (~/Library/Caches/Cypress/<version>), plus Application Support residual caches/logs. Not project cypress/videos or screenshots.
rules.notes: Binary folders are large (hundreds of MB each version). cypress cache prune also works. Do not delete project fixtures.

rules.name: Selenium Manager and WebDriver driver caches
rules.description: Selenium Manager (~/.cache/selenium) drivers/browsers, Python webdriver-manager (~/.wdm), and related chromedriver/geckodriver caches.
rules.notes: Selenium Manager re-resolves drivers on next test run. Safe low-risk reclaim of automation binaries.

rules.name: WebdriverIO residual caches
rules.description: WebdriverIO local caches and service residual folders when present under home cache roots.
rules.notes: WDIO often reuses Playwright/Selenium caches covered by sibling rules; this covers WDIO-specific residual dirs.

rules.name: BrowserStack Local binary and app caches
rules.description: BrowserStack Local tunnel binary under ~/.browserstack and native app caches (com.browserstack.Local).
rules.notes: Binary re-downloads on next local test. Exclude credential-like filenames if present under .browserstack.

rules.name: Sauce Labs Connect residual caches and logs
rules.description: Sauce Connect proxy residual dirs, caches, and home config cache leaves (not stored credentials).
rules.notes: Sauce Connect logs also land in $TMPDIR as sc-*.log (covered by generic tmp aging elsewhere). Do not wipe auth config files.

rules.name: LambdaTest Underpass tunnel caches and logs
rules.description: LambdaTest (TestMu) Underpass desktop tunnel app logs/caches and Lambda tunnel residual home dirs.
rules.notes: Official docs place Underpass logs at ~/Library/Application Support/Underpass/logs on macOS.

rules.name: Lighthouse CI and PageSpeed residual caches
rules.description: Lighthouse CI (.lighthouseci), lighthouse CLI caches, and PageSpeed Insights CLI residual caches.
rules.notes: Project-local .lighthouseci under repos is not targeted (home roots only). Reports regenerate on next audit.

rules.name: Chrome for Testing channel caches
rules.description: Chrome for Testing channel HTTP/code caches used by automation stacks alongside Playwright/Puppeteer downloads.
rules.notes: Complements puppeteer/playwright binary rules; this is the installed channel profile cache, not the versioned browser tarball cache.
